caption: The drawing features a central colored image of a ceramic pitcher, rendered in shades of brown, tan, and hints of purple, with a distinct handle and an irregular, wavy rim. The surface also shows some darker and lighter patches, giving it a textured appearance. The pitcher features the sculpted face of a person on its side. Surrounding the central colored image are four sketches placed in the corners, two at the top and two at the bottom. The sketches at the top left and bottom left provide different profile and frontal views of the pitcher and its sculpted face, while the sketches at the top right and bottom right show a top-down and a bottom-up cross-section of the pitcher. These sketches are drawn in fine pencil or ink, without any color. All of the images and sketches are arranged within simple rectangular borders, providing a clear and organized composition on a plain, off-white background.
title: Toby Pottery Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
